eval_set_title: FF++ official test split, seven compression levels
manuscript_role: b7 — the 4.0 M capacity- and augmentation-matched spatial backbone that fired the STOP-gate.
score_semantics: Raw fake-class logit, mean-pooled over the video's 32 sampled frames — no sigmoid is applied anywhere in the evaluation path. AUC is rank-based, so the scale is immaterial; apply a sigmoid if you want probabilities.
order_contract: video_id/method/label/score are parallel arrays in the original evaluation order; that order is shared across runs and is the pairing basis of the paired video bootstrap (keys_sha256 pins it).
